# [DAFD tutorial: A design automation tool for microfluidic droplet generation developed by CIDAR lab.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iu9hfXpXPbs)

**Visibility**: Public
**Uploaded by**: [CIDAR LAB](http://www.youtube.com/@cidarlab)
**Uploaded at**: 2021-01-04T10:45:51-08:00
**Published at**: 2021-01-04T10:45:51-08:00
**Length**: 02:27
**Views**: 1815
**Likes**: 11
**Category**: Education

## Description

```
DAFD is the first microfluidic design automation software to deliver a user-specified performance using machine learning. DAFD can be used for performance prediction, design automation, and tolerance prediction of flow-focusing droplet generators. You can use this tool online at: http://dafdcad.org/. DAFD is open-source and available at: https://github.com/CIDARLAB/DAFD

The paper accompanying this tool has been published in Nature Communications: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-020-20284-z
```
